takeaways.text: Lines up **Inline (tight)** on **60%** of 144 plays (n=87); also Slot 27% (n=39).

From **EMPTY** (formation), route rate is **100%** (CI 90–100%, n=36) — more likely to run a route than his overall 82%.
Primary alignment is Inline (tight) (60%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
